notes.title: The noise-o-matic 1.5.0.0 major FREE update is live!
notes.notes:
[b]Scare your friends this Halloween with the free 1.5.0.0 Noise-o-matic update![/b]

[previewyoutube=nqtkoGLo-2I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]

[*]added new Sherpa TTS engine:
    [*] download voices from a list of free voices and use them out of the box!
    [*] use your own voices (for advanced users only as it requires AI training outside of Noise-o-matic) - a guide on how to add models is available here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3351834015
            
[*] added discord rich presence
            
[*] recorder improvements
    [*] added window recording (aka shadow recording or flashback recording)
    [*] added the ability to edit / save the current recording without stopping the session 
    
[*] various installation, compatibility and bug fixes 

[/list]

Unsure which sounds to use? Check out this small collection of sounds for Halloween in the Steam workshop (and make sure to share some of your favorite sounds too!)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3351187892
